programs.title: PSG — State of Perpetual Growth
programs.summary: A continuous progression program for strength, size and mobility. 7-day cycle: upper, mobility, lower, mobility, upper, lower, then Sunday mobility if soreness is low (otherwise rest). Every strength day runs the same 50-40-30-20-10 movements at lighter weight; the heavy Long days are break cycles — rare and far apart.

programs.title: 12-Week Dream Lean
programs.summary: STRONG · FUNCTIONAL · CONFIDENT. The complete system for a lean, toned and powerful you. 7-day training split with strength training 4-6 days per week, daily movement reset, health shots, ice bath protocol and acupressure mat recovery.

programs.title: 6-Week Shoulder & Rotator Cuff Protocol
programs.summary: Progressive release and eccentric shoulder/rotator cuff system. The #1 Rule: Shoulders live in your pockets. Phase 1 (Weeks 1-2): Decompression, exploratory range and cuff control. Phase 2 (Weeks 3-4): End-range control and cervical rotation. Phase 3 (Weeks 5-6): Full cervical control and global integration.

programs.title: 6-Week Hip Protocol
programs.summary: Build tolerance, improve control, reduce irritation. Build strong, stable, pain-free hips through controlled movement, glute engagement and core stability. Daily exercises for all 6 weeks with weekly progressions.

programs.title: Back Stability Protocol
programs.summary: Foundation & Activation — the starting point for your hip and lower back protocol. Baseline phase with wall-supported hip/glute activation and pelvic floor work, progressing through 12 weeks of dynamic stability. Activate, Connect, Stabilize, Progress.

programs.title: 6-Week Knee Protocol
programs.summary: Build tolerance, improve control, reduce irritation. Week 1: establish daily habits, activate the right muscles, and introduce gentle movement without pain. A new focus every week through week 6.

programs.title: 4-Week Plantar Fasciitis Protocol
programs.summary: Loosen the tight tissues, gently mobilize the foot and ankle, and start loading the calf with controlled eccentric drops, then build foot and calf strength week by week.

programs.title: 4-Week Elbow Epicondylitis Protocol: Wrist Flexors
programs.summary: A 4-week plan to reduce elbow epicondylitis pain and restore strength, built on slow eccentric work for the wrist flexors. Week 1: calm pain, start healing.

programs.title: 4-Week Elbow Epicondylitis Protocol: Wrist Extensors
programs.summary: A 4-week plan to reduce elbow epicondylitis pain and restore strength, built on slow eccentric work for the wrist extensors. Week 1: calm pain, start healing.

programs.title: 6-Week Low Back, Mid-Back & Hip Flexor Protocol
programs.summary: A 6-week progressive eccentric, glute-driven and full-range system to restore mobility and reduce pain in the low back, mid-back, hips and pelvis. The same movements all 6 weeks, taken to greater length, stretch and control as you progress.

programs.title: 12-Week Full Mobility System
programs.summary: A dual-track program with weekly integration: Track A (posterior chain eccentric protocol) and Track B (mobility conditioning circuit). Weeks 1-2 lean toward mobility; from week 3 the balance shifts toward strength.

programs.title: Mobility Ladder
programs.summary: Dr. Jared's mobility ladder. Same six movements each round. Get as many rounds as you can in under 30 minutes. When you can fit another round in under 30 minutes, add another round. When you can take levels of assistance away, take them away. Increase your depth, not your reps.

programs.title: Anti-Inflammatory Reset
programs.summary: Gentle full-body strength, mobility and daily walking to calm things down without flaring them up. 3 sessions a week for 4 weeks.

programs.title: 6-Week Beginner Golf Protocol
programs.summary: Improve mobility, build better movement and develop a stronger swing. 3 sessions a week for 6 weeks — mobility first, form always.

programs.title: Pickleball Beginner Protocol
programs.summary: Move better, play longer and lower your injury risk. Mobility, stability, strength, power, endurance and court confidence — 3 sessions a week for 6 weeks.

programs.title: Running Performance
programs.summary: Hip strength, calf and foot work, and single-leg stability to run faster with fewer injuries. 3 sessions a week to pair with your runs.

programs.title: Marathon Prep
programs.summary: A 12-week strength-and-mobility block to carry you through marathon training without breaking down. 4 sessions a week built around your run calendar.

programs.title: Pickleball Intermediate Protocol
programs.summary: Stability, strength, power, control and court confidence: build lower-body power, rotational control and court-ready movement. 3 workouts a week for 6 weeks.

programs.title: Pickleball Advanced Protocol
programs.summary: Power, speed, reaction, resilience and next-level performance. 3 workouts a week for 6 weeks.

programs.title: 6-Week Intermediate Golf Program
programs.summary: Rotational strength, power and control to build on your beginner foundation and develop a stronger, more consistent swing.

programs.title: 6-Week Advanced Golf Program
programs.summary: Advanced power, speed and integrated movement for a faster, more efficient swing.

programs.title: Advanced Ski Program
programs.summary: An 8-week plan for power, single-leg dominance and reactive stability: stronger ankles, more control, less fatigue, bigger days on snow.

programs.title: Marathon Contingency: 12-Week Extension
programs.summary: Weeks 9-20 plus the final 3-week taper: build endurance, maintain form, stay healthy and reach 26.2.
